correctness.rationale: Direct interval correlation gives T_(ell+a)+T_(ell-a)-2T_ell for the self terms, the two tents at ±ell, and cancels the mixed terms except for the negative tents at ±d (the shorter interval produces the flat part of each mixed overlap). Plancherel in the stated 2pi convention turns the squared intensity norm into the four-tent energy. Positive and negative supports separate as a<ell; the only cross terms are same-side pairs at distance g. The tent autocorrelation is the convolution of four centered length-a boxes, equivalently the cubic truncated-power difference with knots -2a,-a,0,a,2a. It gives 2a^3/3-ag^2+g^3/2 up to a, (2a-g)^3/6 up to 2a, and zero thereafter. Substitution in 8a^3/3-4C_a(g) verifies the joins and plateau. For the quotient distance, reflection fixes E_0. Its L1 translation discrepancy is continuous, strictly positive off zero and constant at large translations. Triangle inequality forces any minimizer into a small fixed neighborhood of zero as a tends to zero; there the endpoints do not interact and the cost is 2|t-a/2|+2|t+a/2|, minimized at 2a. At fixed positive gap this proves exactly the stated obstruction, not an upper estimate for arbitrary pairs. The checker named in RESULT.md:68 was not supplied or replayed; the reasoning is analytic.
